name: PhotoCraft v0.8.2

body:
## What's Changed
* docs: register the MCP server from an installed release by @sawizzle in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2185

* Preserve unchanged XMP translations in File Info by @Benziza in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2152
* Smudge: use the Brush Settings spacing for retouch strokes (#2140) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2171
* Fix layer mask toggle action labels by @optimalbytee in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2156
* Fix hyperlink in credits panel by @crqch in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2146
* Layers: mask thumbnails update after Invert and other whole-mask edits (#2117) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2164
* Keep the selection when smart selection finds nothing by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2235
* fix(layer style): wrap Make/Reset Default buttons by @kmnkv1 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2209
* i18n(ru): translate layer style effects by @kmnkv1 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2210
* Layers panel: Opacity and Fill share one right-aligned column (#2085) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2173
* Ignore hidden RGB when Magic Wand selects transparency by @harrisonoconnorhover in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2273
* Canvas: clip the Free Transform preview to the canvas (#2027) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2201
* fix(ui): avoid drawing panel borders twice by @tropicaaal in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2226
* Layers panel: press-drag-release picks a fill or adjustment layer (#2071) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2172
* fix(engine): select neighbouring layer after deletion by @kotulsky in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2189
* Preferences: the dialog grows with the window by @luniiya in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2155
* scorecard: Marquee modifiers and brush resize drag are done (TOOL-214-2, TOOL-213-10) by @Duke242 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2261
* Confirm layer deletion only from the Layers trash button by @kotulsky in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2197
* Soft brushes paint soft strokes and thin lines stay even: a Gaussian-like tip and area coverage for tiny tips by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2167
* TGA: save the document's alpha channel as 32-bit alpha (#2124) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2157
* Preserve quoted multiline variable CSV records by @harrisonoconnorhover in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2242
* Workspace: wire open_documents_as_tabs preference (#204) by @Hathor875 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2177
* Expose Clone Stamp opacity and flow and apply them to strokes by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2256
* Masks: target a new layer mask and keep separate colour pairs for mask and pixels (#2166) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2200
* Default layered edits of flat images to PSD on Save by @harrisonoconnorhover in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2234
* Selection cursors: badges for cutting, copying and dragging the selected pixels by @texjer in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2250
* Tools: double-clicking a layer mask launches Select and Mask with preference (#204) by @Hathor875 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2161
* Add pixel mask density and feather controls to Properties by @harrisonoconnorhover in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2240
* Cmd held is the Move tool with the painting tools (Cmd+Alt duplicates) by @texjer in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2248
* Hand tool: an open hand and a fist as the pointer on Windows, and the fist while panning everywhere (#2196) by @Sir-Starch in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2221
* Move tool on a locked layer: Photoshop's message by @texjer in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2249
* fix(ui): remove the gap beneath Spectrum document tabs by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2265
* Web: leave the JPEG XL DNG decoder out of the wasm (25.1 MB -> 24.3 MB) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2233
* fix(ui): mode buttons respect two-column toolbar by @tropicaaal in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2241
* Layer › Rasterize acts on every selected layer; the Layers menu offers "Rasterize Layers" (#2243) by @Sir-Starch in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2253
* Fix SVG selection and import detection by @alex-ctms in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2224
* Pen pressure curve: Preferences › Tools shapes how pen pressure reaches every brush by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2195
* feat(ui): allow toolbar to scroll by @tropicaaal in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2238
* GPU startup: CPU mode on Linux falls back to Vulkan to present the window (#1337) by @MrCloudy2 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2206
* Layers menu and layer commands follow the selection, not the active layer (#2244) by @Sir-Starch in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2254
* Window edges: easier to grab, theme-safe cursors, and no lost hover after a resize (#1581) by @MrCloudy2 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2205

* fix(ui): complete system appearance selection and styling by @coygeek in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2168
* Add the Remove tool with non-local patch completion by @JohnnYoru in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2193

* Expand arithmetic expressions across numeric inputs by @TheSeanLavery in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2252
* automation: accept absolute paths beneath the automation roots (#2176) by @SBaksa in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2216
* Filters: preview at the scale OK applies (#2063) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2207
* Load Thai fallback fonts for native UI text by @harrisonoconnorhover in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2280
* Content-Aware tools: Photoshop's behaviour, measured by @Unemars in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2202
* Apply Type formatting to selected text layers by @harrisonoconnorhover in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2266
* Distance fields on threads: bevel size changes 2-3x cheaper (#2119) by @Sir-Starch in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2162
* EXR: Cryptomatte layers list, decode and hash to the specification by @Elvis33LE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2180
* Expose native shape stroke controls with staged previews by @optimalbytee in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2218
* Select and Mask: 4x faster CPU refinement with exact octagonal morphology by @excited-raccoon in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2154
* Addition : Brush popup better UI by @siraxe in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2217
* kys import: first launch asks before importing; edit.keyboardShortcuts importKys (#1987 review) by @texjer in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2251

* Canvas: UI Scale must not magnify the image (#2121) by @maxm11 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2333

body:
## What's Changed
* Motion Blur: 6x to 70x faster (one merged kernel applied over whole rows) by @Ar-maan05 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/902
* Applying a text data set re-renders the type layer instead of blanking it (#990) by @ianswope in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1025
* PSD: a spec-order mask record is not misread as Photoshop's order when that reading is implausible (#949) by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1129
* ui.window.open: an invalid document index is an error, not a side effect by @Elvis33LE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1133
* fix(ui): remember previously applied New Guide Layout values by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1261
* fix(ui): allow removing the last polygonal lasso point by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1262
* PSD export: write empty layer and mask channels as raw by @DWAA1660 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1290
* Fix #1286: Delete and Fill Selection on the selection tools' right-click menu by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1331
* Part of #1275: the Studio themes show the Move tool's Auto-Select toggle by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1333
* Fix #1323: a Distort corner stops before the box folds over by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1332
* chore: remove accidentally committed fb-*.log files and ignore *.log by @ArianPashae in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1155
* Filter › Last Filter applies to the active layer, not the layer the filter first ran on (#1270) by @marcardenas in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1307
* Gradient tool: a handle dragged past the 10% scale floor stops; the other handle stays put (#1243) by @marcardenas in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1306
* fix(ui): prevent hidden guides from intercepting canvas input by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1268
* fix(ui): display configured Quick Export format in File menu by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1269
* fix(export): add WebP quality controls to Export Preferences by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1279
* PSD text fill: keep FillFlag so Photopea-edited text keeps its fill, carrying #1240 by @ragedotdev by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1368
* Free Transform: W/H and X/Y fields reach large documents, carrying #1295 by @marcardenas by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1340
* Select › Modify: Apply effect at canvas bounds, carrying #1296 by @marcardenas by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1339
* Layers panel: hovering a blend mode previews it live on the canvas (#970) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1081
* docs: craftrules is not public — say so instead of linking it (#493) by @bfenty in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/779
* i18n: fix pt-br label collisions (Feather/Diffuse, Liquify/Dissolve) by @RicSchonfelder in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/833
* Never crash on hostile numbers: LUT sizes, Quick Selection points, link group ids by @tanish2k09 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/869
* A PSD layer with bounds but no channel data no longer aborts on a 360 GB allocation (#755) by @ianswope in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/885
* New Document: a Clipboard preset with the clipboard image's size by @jason4short in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/891
* Layer copies are numbered: "Layer 1 copy 2", not "Layer 1 copy copy" by @jason4short in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/897

## What's Changed
* Add rendering modes and CPU fallback recovery by @TheSeanLavery in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/434
* Type layers keep their name in step with their text (#483) by @mnmlyw in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/501
* Unsaved-changes prompt: (D)on't Save / (C)ancel / (S)ave keys, Tab order by @sommerper in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/533
* Layer Style: the shadow/bevel Angle slider now moves the light (#350) by @agorevski in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/411
* Color Picker: sample colours from the image with a pipette by @carterwsmith in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/508
* Polygonal Lasso: double-click closes the polygon; a new polygon replaces the selection in one step by @rosematcha in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/361
* Type: the Color panel, Swatches and Color Picker recolor selected text by @rosematcha in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/364
* Free Transform: Undo steps through the transform; handles are easier to grab by @rosematcha in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/365
* 32-bit documents: Levels don't clip the input and output ranges by @floflo777 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/403
* rustfmt discard_ui.rs (CI Format step red since #533) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/597
* Smart objects keep their four-corner (Distort / Perspective) placement by @jason4short in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/426
* feat(ui): add bounded Liquify redo history by @agorevski in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/435
* Lasso inside liquify mode , with hotkeys L, alt , ctrl+i, ctrl+h for … by @siraxe in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/453
* Expose the Mixer Brush as a UI tool (#213) by @agorevski in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/433
* Control protocol docs: file.open/file.save are refused over --control (#379) by @floflo777 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/391
* docs: sync scorecard with implemented behavior by @arpitkjaiswal in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/348
* Focus PhotoCraft for unsaved close prompt by @TheSeanLavery in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/547

## Highlights since 0.2.0

182 commits from 183 merged pull requests, including work from 31 community contributors (thank you!), and 146 issues closed.

- **Your work is safer:**
  - Recovered unsaved documents survive a second crash.
  - Deeply nested `.pcraft` files reopen.
  - `photocraft-cli batch` refuses to overwrite its input folder.
  - Preferences no longer get lost when two windows or tabs save, or when a save fails.
- **Languages:** the interface is available in 日本語, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Español, Русский and Čeština (Edit › Preferences › Interface › Language), with CJK fonts and IME input in the Type tool.
- **Files:**
  - JPEG and other no-alpha exports composite transparency over white.
  - Formats without colour profiles get sRGB.
  - Truncated JPEGs and multi-frame files open with a warning instead of silently.
  - TGA is offered in Save As and Export As.
- **Editing:**
  - Free Transform a Copy and Transform Again on a Copy.
  - Keyboard layer navigation, number keys for opacity, Alt-click colour sampling.
  - New from Clipboard.
  - Undo and redo restore the targeted layer.
  - Shortcuts pressed in quick succession all run, in order.
- **Automation (CLI, MCP, control channel):**
  - Stricter, clearer parameter and flag errors, and `<subcommand> --help`.
  - Background jobs that agents can wait for or poll.
  - Recorded actions run in `batch`.

## Scorecard

This is the first release with [`docs/scorecard.md`](https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/blob/v0.3.0/docs/scorecard.md), so these numbers are its baseline. 0.2.0 had no scorecard to compare against. Area counts are done / partial / missing.

body:
## Upgrade notes

- **Automation (MCP / control channel) now needs explicit file roots.** File access from automation clients is limited to folders you grant with `--automation-read-root <dir>` / `--automation-write-root <dir>` (or `PHOTOCRAFT_AUTOMATION_READ_ROOT` / `PHOTOCRAFT_AUTOMATION_WRITE_ROOT`), and paths must be relative to them. Without roots, automation file operations fail closed. The desktop control channel also requires the per-launch token printed at startup. Interactive file dialogs and one-shot CLI commands are unaffected.
- **Camera RAW:** DNG, Canon CR2, Sony ARW (lossless and compressed), Panasonic RW2 and uncompressed Olympus ORF now decode. Nikon's compressed NEF and other formats still open their embedded full-size preview for now.

## What's Changed
